SELECT c.id AS concertId, c.title AS title, c.subtitle AS subtitle, c.category AS category, c.age_rating AS ageRating, c.poster_url AS posterUrl, COUNT(rs.id) AS completedReservationSeatCount
FROM v1_concerts c
INNER JOIN v1_performances p ON p.concert_id = c.id
INNER JOIN v1_reservations r ON r.performance_id = p.id AND r.status = 'COMPLETED'
INNER JOIN v1_reservation_seats rs ON rs.reservation_id = r.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.category, c.age_rating, c.poster_url
ORDER BY completedReservationSeatCount DESC, c.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
